source_definition: Stores the Parent Requirement ID preserved from the requirements spreadsheet for an official SbD requirement. Preserved parent/grouping identifier from the SbD source spreadsheet.
target_definition: States whether a particular OSO robustness assignment is required for the given SAIL. False represents an NR assignment and therefore no robustness level is required.
review_notes: String parent identifier is unrelated to a Boolean SAIL requirement indicator.

source_definition: Records the likelihood value or descriptor used in risk assessment. Qualitative descriptor or numeric likelihood value.
target_definition: Stores the ordinal position of a SAIL value from I through VI for ordering/query support.
review_notes: Risk likelihood is unrelated to the ordinal position of a SAIL level.
